executive_summary: Maven compilation failed due to a method signature mismatch in TaskManagementController. The controller is calling getUserTasks() with a Pageable parameter, but the TaskService interface expects two int parameters (page and size). This is a straightforward API contract violation that requires updating either the service interface to accept Pageable or the controller to extract page/size from Pageable.

errors.message: method getUserTasks cannot be applied: required (Long,int,int), found (Long,Pageable)
errors.root_cause: The TaskManagementController is calling taskService.getUserTasks() with parameters (Long userId, Pageable pageable), but the TaskService interface defines getUserTasks() with signature (Long userId, int page, int size). This is a method signature mismatch between the controller and service interface.
errors.fix_recommendation: Update TaskService.getUserTasks() method signature to accept Pageable instead of separate int parameters: 'Page<TaskDTO> getUserTasks(Long userId, Pageable pageable)'. Then update the implementation class accordingly. Alternatively, extract page and size from Pageable in the controller: 'taskService.getUserTasks(userId, pageable.getPageNumber(), pageable.getPageSize())'.
